jobs.prompt: Create a production 2D RPG ANIMATION SPRITE SHEET using the attached guardian carpenter beaver as the exact identity and style reference. Preserve chestnut beaver fur, cream muzzle, two front teeth, small round ears, broad flat crosshatched paddle tail, green carpenter apron, tan shirt, leafy shoulder pad, wooden mallet in anatomical RIGHT hand and wooden shield on anatomical LEFT arm. Painterly storybook texture, clean strong contours, fixed elevated 3/4 game camera and upper-left light. Square image, exactly 4 ROWS and 4 COLUMNS, 16 complete separated frames, actual transparent alpha. No typography, no cell borders, no floor, no backdrop, no painted checkerboard. Each frame entirely inside an equal square cell, 15 percent safety padding; no image touching another frame. Row 1 faces down/front; row 2 faces right; row 3 faces up/back; row 4 faces left. All four frames within a row show the SAME direction and SAME character scale, feet around the same horizontal baseline, no translation across the cell. Read left to right as time progresses. This must show clearly different sequential motion poses, NOT repeated idle turnarounds. Keep shape, outfit, handedness and weapon design stable. Animation source art, not an infographic. Animation: a four-frame WALK CYCLE. Column 1 left foot stepping forward, right foot behind; column 2 passing pose with feet crossing under body, body lifted slightly; column 3 right foot forward, left foot behind; column 4 opposite passing pose back towards frame 1. Arms and held tools gently counter-swing, broad tail slightly counterbalances. Clear leg articulation even under apron. Do not swing weapons as an attack, do not add dust/VFX.
